verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs list "audit logs" among its enterprise security features, so some change logging exists, but nothing describes recording who changed what in the model, or when. Nothing documents rolling changes back; "versioned forecasts" refers to forecast versions for scenario planning and is not evidence of change history or rollback. missing for 10: documented per-change attribution (user, field, timestamp) for model edits, rollback/restore of prior model states, in-depth audit-log documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every change to the model is logged with who changed what and when, and can be rolled back

citations.quote: Keep your data safe with enterprise-grade security featuring access controls, fine-grained permissions, audit logs, and more.
